label: Galleri sensitivity (upper GI)
description: P(Galleri +ve with esophagus/stomach signal | prevalent upper GI cancer)
source: PATHFINDER 2 episode sensitivity for 12 deadly cancers 69.8% x CSO accuracy 91.3% (GRAIL 2026); range CCGA3 stage I-II to all-stage (Klein 2021)

label: Galleri E/S signal (other cancer)
description: P(Galleri +ve with esophagus/stomach signal | prevalent cancer elsewhere that the workup can find)
source: Overall episode sensitivity 39.3% x CSO error 8.7% (PATHFINDER 2) x assumed 20% of wrong CSOs called E/S

label: Galleri sensitivity in repeat rounds (ratio to first round)
description: Multiplier on Galleri sensitivity (upper GI and other cancers) in every round after the first (incidence rounds)
source: NHS-Galleri episode sensitivity, 12 prespecified cancers: 63.4% round 1 vs 47.6% and 50.7% rounds 2-3, mean 49.2% / 63.4% = 0.775 (Neal 2026)

label: Missed cancers stay missed by Galleri
description: Share of upper GI cancers missed by Galleri that remain undetectable by Galleri at later rounds (0 = each round independent)
source: Assumption; scenario 1 = a missed (non-shedding) cancer is never detected by later Galleri tests

label: Galleri false-positive rate (E/S)
description: P(Galleri +ve with esophagus/stomach signal | no cancer)
source: False-positive rate 0.36% (PATHFINDER 2 specificity 99.64%) x assumed 10% with an E/S CSO

label: EGD sensitivity
description: EGD sensitivity for a preclinical upper GI cancer present at the EGD (both arms). Misses split by f_invisible into visible-but-missed and not-yet-visible
source: 1 - 11.3% upper GI cancers missed at EGD within 3 years (Menon & Trudgill 2014)

label: P(EGD +ve)
description: Validation target only (not used by the engine since Nov 2026): share of Galleri esophagus/stomach positives whose EGD finds an upper GI cancer. The model's own EGD +ve share now follows from sensitivity, prevalence and EGD sensitivity
source: Derived: stomach/esophagus CSO PPV 64.6% (NHS-Galleri; Neal 2026) x CSO1 accuracy 87% (real-world; Matrana 2025) x EGD sensitivity 88.7% (Menon 2014)

label: P(routed to ENT)
description: EGD -ve patients routed to ENT evaluation (rest go to PET CT)
source: No published data: a local pathway choice. Set from your protocol or counts.csv

label: P(ENT +ve)
description: ENT evaluation +ve
source: No published rate for head and neck cancer behind an E/S signal (case series only: Talwar 2026). Wide uncertainty

label: P(PET pancreatobiliary +ve)
description: PET CT pancreatobiliary finding (PET -ve is the remainder of the group)
source: Anchored on PATHFINDER 2: PET/CT after a negative targeted workup found cancer in 7/63 (11.1%); half assumed pancreatobiliary (70% malignant x EUS sensitivity 91%)

label: P(PET incidental +ve)
description: PET CT incidental non-GI/non-pancreatobiliary finding
source: Anchored on PATHFINDER 2 PET/CT yield 11.1%; half assumed from incidental findings that are malignant one-third of the time

label: P(missed cancer | -ve workup)
description: Cancer diagnosed within 12 months of a negative workup
source: PATHFINDER 2: 4 of ~117 positives with no cancer at diagnostic resolution were diagnosed with cancer within 12 months (Nabavizadeh 2026)

label: P(cancer | incidental finding)
description: Share of incidental PET +ve findings that are cancer (rest are benign)
source: Incidental FDG PET/CT findings malignant about one-third of the time: thyroid 30.8% (de Leijer 2021 meta-analysis); breast 33.5%; prostate 21.3%

label: P(late | screen-detected)
description: Share of screen-detected cancers that are late stage
source: PATHFINDER 2: 53% of Galleri-detected cancers stage I-II (GRAIL 2026)

label: Odds ratio on SEER late-stage share
description: Multiplies the odds of late stage at symptomatic diagnosis; the base value (1) reproduces SEER stage distribution for each subgroup
source: Stage at symptomatic diagnosis calibrated to SEER 2010-2016 by site, race and sex (CSR Tables 8.8, 24.8); SE assumed for PSA

label: Preclinical sojourn time
description: Mean years an undiagnosed cancer stays preclinical before symptoms (annual presentation = 1 - exp(-1/sojourn))
source: Gastric cancer mean sojourn time 2.37 y (95% CI 1.92-2.96; Bae et al. 2014)

label: Cancer mortality after early dx
description: Annual probability of cancer death after early-stage diagnosis
source: From SEER 5-y relative survival localized (esophagus 48.6%; stomach 78.1%) = 66.1%: 1 - 0.661^(1/5)

label: Cancer mortality after late dx
description: Annual probability of cancer death after late-stage diagnosis
source: From SEER 5-y relative survival regional/distant (stage-weighted) = 18.6%: 1 - 0.186^(1/5)

label: P(perforation | EGD)
description: Perforation per diagnostic upper GI endoscopy (Galleri +ve workup and Kunzmann screening EGDs)
source: ASGE 2012: perforation 1/2,500-1/11,000 diagnostic EGDs (midpoint); Bhatia 2008: 0.03%

label: P(death | EGD perforation)
description: Case fatality of an iatrogenic esophageal perforation; a fatal perforation ends the workup
source: Pooled mortality 9.75% (95% CI 5.9-13.6%), 25 studies, 596 patients with non-surgical iatrogenic perforation (Papaconstantinou 2026); 13.2% for iatrogenic perforation (Biancari 2013)

label: P(serious AE | ENT)
description: Serious adverse event per ENT evaluation (nasolaryngoscopy)
source: Flexible laryngoscopy: serious events very rare; assumed

label: P(serious AE | EUS)
description: Serious adverse event per diagnostic EUS
source: Perforation 0.02-0.06% (ASGE 2022; Forbes)

label: P(serious AE | EUS sampling)
description: Additional serious adverse event risk per EUS sampling (FNA/FNB)
source: Bleeding 0.18% + pancreatitis 0.44% after EUS-FNA (ASGE 2022; Forbes)

label: P(death | other serious AE)
description: Share of non-perforation serious adverse events (ENT, EUS, EUS sampling) that are fatal
source: Assumed

label: PET CT dose (mSv)
description: Effective radiation dose per PET CT
source: PET-CT with low-dose CT 14.0 +/- 1.3 mSv (Quinn 2016); 24.4 mSv with diagnostic CT

label: Cancer risk per Sv
description: Lifetime excess cancer risk per sievert
source: ICRP 103 nominal risk coefficient adults 4.1% per Sv

label: QALY/DALY loss per radiation cancer
description: QALYs (and DALYs) lost per radiation-induced cancer
source: Assumed (radiogenic cancers arise decades later)

label: Days to EGD
description: Days from Galleri result (or risk score) to EGD
source: Assumed; full pathway total consistent with PATHFINDER median 79 days (PATHFINDER 2: 48)

label: Days to ENT
description: Days from previous step to ENT evaluation
source: Assumed (see t_egd)

label: Days to PET CT
description: Days from previous step to PET CT
source: Assumed (see t_egd)

label: Days to EUS
description: Days from previous step to EUS
source: Assumed (see t_egd)

label: Days to tumor board
description: Days from previous step to tumor board
source: Assumed (see t_egd)

label: Cost Galleri test
description: Galleri test
source: GRAIL list price $949 (not covered by Medicare)

label: Share of Galleri price charged to upper GI
description: Share of the Galleri test price attributed to upper GI cancer screening
source: Base case charges the full price. Scenario 0.077: esophagus 4.5% of MCED-detected cancers in NHS-Galleri (Neal 2026) x 1.7 for stomach (assumed stomach:esophagus ratio 0.7)

label: Cost Kunzmann scoring
description: Applying the Kunzmann score (clinician/admin time)
source: Assumed

label: Cost EGD
description: Upper GI endoscopy with biopsy
source: Medicare 2024 CPT 43239: OPPS $864.59 + physician $136.48

label: Cost ENT evaluation
description: ENT evaluation (flexible laryngoscopy)
source: Medicare 2026 CPT 31575 non-facility $127.26 (procedure only; excludes office visit) (2026 fee schedule; no CPI for 2026 yet, used as 2025 USD)

label: Cost PET CT
description: PET CT
source: Medicare OPPS CPT 78815 $1458.59 (July 2025; facility component)

label: Cost EUS
description: Endoscopic ultrasound
source: Medicare 2024 CPT 43237: OPPS $1814.88 + physician $192.07

label: Cost EUS sampling
description: EUS sampling (FNA/FNB) incl. pathology
source: CPT 43238 vs 43237 adds $35.62 (Medicare 2024) + assumed pathology ~$115

label: Cost tumor board
description: Tumor board discussion
source: Assumed

label: Cost symptomatic diagnosis
description: Diagnostic workup when a cancer presents with symptoms
source: Assumed (EGD with biopsy + staging CT/PET)

label: First-year cost early dx
description: Treatment cost in the year of an early-stage diagnosis
source: Initial-phase cancer care cost (Mariotto et al. JNCI 2026; USD 2023)

label: First-year cost late dx
description: Treatment cost in the year of a late-stage diagnosis
source: Stage IV stomach cancer first-year cost (Reddy et al. 2022; SEER-Medicare 2012-2016; price year assumed 2019)

label: Annual cost after early dx
description: Annual follow-up/continuing care cost after early-stage diagnosis
source: Continuing-phase cost (Mariotto et al. JNCI 2026; USD 2023)

label: Annual cost after late dx
description: Annual continuing care cost after late-stage diagnosis
source: Assumed 3 x continuing-phase cost (ongoing systemic therapy)

label: End-of-life cost
description: Cost of terminal care at cancer death
source: Last-year-of-life cost for cancer deaths (Mariotto et al. JNCI 2026; USD 2023)

label: Cost other serious AE
description: Cost of managing a non-perforation serious adverse event (ENT, EUS, EUS sampling)
source: Assumed

label: Cost EGD perforation
description: Cost of managing an EGD perforation (admission, endoscopic stent or surgical repair)
source: Assumed; mean hospital stay 32.9 days after esophageal perforation (Biancari 2013); no US cost estimate found

label: Cost follow-up of incidental PET finding
description: Follow-up of an incidental (non-GI, non-pancreatobiliary) PET finding: targeted imaging and/or biopsy (benign or cancer)
source: Assumed (e.g. thyroid ultrasound + FNA, or colonoscopy); one diagnostic procedure, QALY loss d_proc

label: Utility multiplier early dx
description: Utility after early-stage diagnosis as a share of age-specific baseline utility
source: Esophageal cancer EQ-5D stage I 0.66 and II/III 0.84 (Petric 2025) over US norm ~0.82 (Jiang 2021)

label: Utility multiplier late dx
description: Utility after late-stage diagnosis as a share of age-specific baseline utility
source: Esophageal cancer EQ-5D stage IV 0.67 (Petric 2025) over US norm ~0.82 (Jiang 2021)

label: QALY loss per procedure
description: QALY (and DALY) loss per diagnostic procedure for people with cancer and for Kunzmann screening EGDs; for cancer-free people worked up after a Galleri positive only when fp_tto = 0
source: Assumed (includes anxiety while awaiting results)

label: QALY loss per serious AE
description: QALY (and DALY) loss per non-fatal serious adverse event
source: Assumed

label: QALY loss, false positive cleared after EGD + ENT
description: Whole-pathway QALY loss (procedures and uncertainty) for a cancer-free person whose workup ends after EGD and an ENT exam
source: Matza 2024 TTO, false positive for colorectal cancer cleared by colonoscopy (14 days uncertainty): -0.079 (95% CI -0.094 to -0.064)

label: QALY loss, false positive cleared after EGD + PET CT
description: Whole-pathway QALY loss for a cancer-free person whose workup ends with a negative PET CT
source: Matza 2024 TTO, false positive for pancreatic cancer cleared by CT + PET-CT (23 days): -0.088 (95% CI -0.104 to -0.073)

label: QALY loss, extended false-positive workup
description: Whole-pathway QALY loss when the workup goes on to EUS (with or without sampling) or follow-up of an incidental PET finding
source: Matza 2024 TTO, longest pathway (lung false positive with 6-month follow-up scan, 185 days): -0.111 (95% CI -0.130 to -0.091)

label: Use pathway (TTO) disutility for false positives
description: 1 = cancer-free people worked up lose the Matza pathway QALYs (replacing per-procedure d_proc); 0 = per-procedure d_proc only (measured EQ-5D finds no utility loss)
source: Base: preference-based pathway values (Matza 2024). Scenario 0: EQ-5D studies found anxiety but no utility decrement after false positives (Tosteson 2014; Gareen 2014)

label: Disability weight, anxiety while awaiting the all-clear
description: GBD disability weight applied to the days of diagnostic uncertainty (DALYs) and to persisting worry (DALYs and QALYs)
source: GBD 2019 disability weight, anxiety disorders mild 0.030 (0.018-0.046); moderate 0.133 as a scenario

label: Persisting cancer worry after a false positive
description: Share of cancer-free people worked up who still have high cancer worry after the all-clear
source: 17% with high cancer worry (CWS >= 10) 6 months after a false-positive FIT and negative colonoscopy (Vermeer 2020)

label: Duration of persisting worry (years)
description: How long persisting worry lasts, weighted by dw_anx
source: Assumed: worry measured at 6 months (Vermeer 2020); anxiety returns to baseline within a year in most studies (Kim 2022)

label: Disability weight early dx
description: Disability weight while living after early-stage diagnosis (DALYs)
source: GBD 2019 cancer controlled phase 0.049 (diagnosis and primary therapy 0.288)

label: Disability weight late dx
description: Disability weight while living after late-stage diagnosis (DALYs)
source: GBD 2019 metastatic phase 0.451 (terminal 0.540)

label: False-positive persistence (concentration)
description: Concentration of each person's false-positive propensity (beta distribution, mean = fpr_g_es). Very large = repeat tests independent; 3,400 makes a repeat false positive 1.8x the population rate; 2,900 makes it 1.96x
source: No esophagus/stomach-specific data. Scenarios: 3,400 from 7 all-site Galleri retests with no repeat false positive (O'Donnell 2025; Sue 2026); 2,900 from Dutch mammography, 1.96x more false positives after a false positive (Kregting 2023)

label: Cancer risk ratio after a false positive
description: Multiplier on upper GI cancer onset after a false positive, beyond missed and not-yet-visible cancers
source: Base case 1 (no Galleri data). Scenario 2 from mammography: about twice the later cancer risk after a false positive (Roman 2018)

label: EGD hold after a negative EGD
description: Annual rounds after a negative EGD in which a Galleri esophagus/stomach positive skips the EGD and goes straight to ENT/PET CT
source: Shorter of the gastric (2.37 y; Bae 2014) and esophageal adenocarcinoma (4.9 y; Kong 2014) sojourn times, in whole rounds. 0 = no hold

label: Share of EGD misses not yet visible
description: Of upper GI cancers present but not found at an EGD (1 - sens_egd), the share not yet visible; the rest are visible lesions that were missed
source: Root-cause categories A + C, 16.9% + 8.9% of 89 post-endoscopy cancers (Kamran 2023). Range: category C only to 5 of 6 with no visible abnormality (Goetz 2023)

label: Years until a hidden cancer becomes visible
description: Mean time for a not-yet-visible upper GI cancer to become visible on EGD
source: Consistent with the 17-month mean interval from negative EGD to diagnosis (Alexandre 2022) and Galleri's ~1-year detectable window (Hubbell 2026)

label: P(PET CT shows upper GI cancer | EGD skipped)
description: PLACEHOLDER. When the hold skips the EGD and the person has an upper GI cancer, chance PET CT shows it (then EGD)
source: To source: FDG PET CT sensitivity for early esophageal and gastric cancer (low for small lesions)

label: P(FNA/FNB taken at EUS)
description: Whether a tissue sample (FNA/FNB) is taken at EUS: a coin toss, independent of whether the lesion is malignant. Beta(2, 2) in the PSA
source: Your instruction (26 Nov 2026): uncertain, modelled like a coin toss

label: EUS tissue sampling sensitivity
description: Sample positive given a malignant pancreatobiliary lesion is sampled (FNA/FNB)
source: EUS-guided tissue acquisition sensitivity 91% for solid pancreatic lesions (Dig Dis Sci systematic review); previously inside p_eus_pos

label: P(laparoscopy | first negative EUS, tumor board)
description: After a first negative EUS (or no sample), tumor board sends this share to diagnostic laparoscopy; the rest go to watchful waiting
source: Your instruction (26 Nov 2026): small but uncertain

label: Laparoscopy multiplier after a prior negative EUS
description: Repeat pancreatobiliary finding after a negative EUS: P(laparoscopy) = p_tb_lap x this
source: Your instruction: laparoscopy substantially less likely after a negative result

label: Laparoscopy multiplier after a negative laparoscopy
description: Repeat finding after a negative laparoscopy: P(laparoscopy) = p_tb_lap x this
source: Your instruction: lower still after a negative laparoscopy

label: P(repeat EUS | repeat finding, prior negative EUS)
description: Repeat pancreatobiliary finding after a negative EUS: share given a repeat EUS (the rest, after laparoscopy, watchful waiting)
source: Assumed

label: P(repeat EUS | repeat finding, prior negative laparoscopy)
description: Repeat finding after a negative laparoscopy: share given a repeat EUS
source: Assumed

label: Esophageal adenocarcinoma sojourn time
description: Mean preclinical sojourn of esophageal adenocarcinoma, for the site-specific natural-history scenario (not the base case)
source: CISNET models, men: UW-MISCAN 4.9, MGH 7.1 (Kong 2014)

label: P(serious complication | diagnostic laparoscopy)
description: PLACEHOLDER. Serious adverse event after diagnostic laparoscopy
source: To source

label: Days to diagnostic laparoscopy
description: PLACEHOLDER. Days from tumor board to laparoscopy
source: To source (see t_egd)

label: Cost diagnostic laparoscopy
description: PLACEHOLDER. Diagnostic laparoscopy incl. facility and pathology
source: To source: Medicare OPPS + physician fee (CPT 49320)

label: Cost surveillance imaging
description: PLACEHOLDER. One round of watchful-waiting imaging (MRI/MRCP or CT)
source: To source: Medicare rates

label: P(malignant | PET pancreatobiliary +ve)
description: Share of pancreatobiliary PET findings that are cancer (sets what EUS, laparoscopy and watchful waiting find or miss)
source: Previously implicit in p_eus_pos (assumed 70% malignant x 91% tissue sensitivity)

label: Site-specific sojourn time (switch)
description: 1 = preclinical sojourn is the subgroup mix of esophageal adenocarcinoma (sojourn_eac) and other upper GI cancer (sojourn_years), weighted by SEER incidence; 0 = sojourn_years for all (base case)
source: Scenario switch (decision 4, Nov 2026)

label: Kunzmann flags by sex (switch)
description: 1 = sex-specific Kunzmann split (59.7% of men flagged, capture 88.1%; 3.5% of women, capture 15.3%); 0 = pooled evidence-profile values in Settings (base case)
source: Scenario switch: Kunzmann 2018 sex-specific shares with derived capture

label: MISCAN-ESO natural history for esophageal adenocarcinoma (switch)
description: 1 = esophageal adenocarcinoma (EAC) gets its own natural history calibrated to CISNET MISCAN-ESO: sex-specific mean preclinical sojourn, preclinical early -> late progression before symptoms, stage of screen-detected EAC from the stage it is found in; the rest of upper GI cancer keeps sojourn_years. 0 = one natural history for all upper GI cancer (base case)
source: Scenario switch (Nov 2026). Structure after MISCAN-ESO (Erasmus/UW): preclinical localized -> regional -> distant with exponential durations, here collapsed to early (localized) and late (regional/distant) to match SEER summary stage

label: EAC mean preclinical sojourn, men (MISCAN-ESO)
description: Mean time from preclinical EAC to clinical diagnosis, men; used when miscan_eac = 1
source: UW-MISCAN-Esophagus, all men, average over birth cohorts: 4.9 y (Kong 2014, EAC sojourn time results and Figure 6). MISCAN-ESO profile: calibration target 4-5 y, model 5.0 y. Range = the MISCAN calibration target

label: EAC mean preclinical sojourn, women (MISCAN-ESO)
description: Mean time from preclinical EAC to clinical diagnosis, women; used when miscan_eac = 1
source: UW-MISCAN-Esophagus, all women: 4.5 y (Kong 2014). Range = the MISCAN calibration target 4-5 y

label: EAC: mean time in preclinical early / preclinical late
description: Splits the MISCAN sojourn between the early (localized) and late (regional/distant) preclinical phases; 1 = equal mean durations. Sets how much of a screen-detected EAC is early stage
source: MISCAN-ESO publishes the total sojourn (4-5 y) but not its split by stage (profile parameter tables list durations by state without values). Assumption, tested 0.5 and 2

label: EAC cancer mortality after early dx (MISCAN-ESO scenario)
description: Annual probability of cancer death after early-stage (localized) diagnosis of esophageal adenocarcinoma; used when miscan_eac = 1
source: SEER 5-y relative survival, esophagus, localized 48.6%: 1 - 0.486^(1/5). MISCAN-ESO uses SEER stage-specific EAC survival

label: EAC cancer mortality after late dx (MISCAN-ESO scenario)
description: Annual probability of cancer death after late-stage (regional/distant) diagnosis of esophageal adenocarcinoma; used when miscan_eac = 1
source: SEER 5-y relative survival, esophagus, regional 29.1% and distant 5.3%, weighted by SEER stage for White men (regional 33%, distant 41%) = 15.9%: 1 - S^(1/5)
